newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil weakens in line with futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil weakens in line with futures.

text.p: NWE gas oil fell on Monday in line with weaker futures in a fairly quiet market, traders said.
June gas oil was trading $2.75 lower at $161.50 a tonne at 1230 GMT.
Heating oil premiums were quoted at June IPE +50 cents/+$1.50 fob ARA for prompt material and +75 cents/+$1.50 fob ARA for second half delivery.
Two 1,000 tonne parcels of heating oil traded at June IPE +$1.0 a tonne fob Rotterdam for June 10-25 delivery, although the seller conceded it was a good price.
"+$1.0 is do-able it's just a question of getting in there at the right time," he said.
A small parcel of low sulphur material was done at June IPE $7.25 fob Flushing.
There was little activity on the cargo front.

The gas oil contango appeared to have encouraged some traders to put material into storage mopping up some of the Mediterranean cargoes which have hit the area in recent weeks, but traders said the supply situation remained fairly slack. -- London Newsroom, +171 542 7714.
